scope: Required per-component source and build metadata for release evidence binding
before: releaseManifestDigest accepted a component with its source revision removed; new behavioral test failed with missing expected exception
after: Every server/email/worker component requires full source SHA, nonempty build provider and runId; optional attempt must be positive
limitations: Metadata validation and digest binding do not authenticate build provenance
CI must still emit actual source/build records and smoke evidence
No Docker builds, native workflow runs or live cluster changes
